text.en:
There shall be a Lupong Tagapagpaganap that shall serve as the executive unit for Regions IX
and XII. It shall be composed of the members as provided for in Section 14 of Presidential Decree No. 1618
and shall be vested with the same powers and responsibilities as defined in the said Decree and other pertinent
laws, executive orders, letters of instructions, and implementing orders and regulations.

The two existing Lupong Tagapagpaganap ng Pook are hereby abolished upon the expiration of
the terms of office of their present members on 7 May 1982. All records, equipment, buildings, facilities and
properties of the Councils reorganized under this Decree shall be transferred to the Lupong Tagapagpaganap
created herein.

The merging of the two Executive Councils into one Lupong Tagapagpaganap or Executive
Council for Regions IX and XII shall be submitted to the people of said regions in a plebiscite to be
supervised by the Commission on Elections on May 17, 1982, to coincide with the barangay elections.
The merged Executive Council shall hold its sessions in Zamboanga City.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 5th day of April in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and eighty-two.
